records.name: Independent Practitioner — Intermittent Fault Diagnosis
records.description: Demonstrate safe, evidence-based diagnosis of intermittent faults on legacy field systems.
records.pass_condition: Independent unseen case + peer approval; quiz alone cannot complete path.
records.completion_evidence_policy: Practice evidence + peer approval required; knowledge completion or quiz score alone is insufficient.

records.name: Institutional Decision Steward — Procurement Exceptions
records.description: Reconstruct decision rationale, distinguish source facts from reconstruction, and apply the decision framework to novel cases.
records.pass_condition: Accurate rationale reconstruction + novel-case application + peer approval.
records.completion_evidence_policy: Practice evidence + peer approval required; knowledge completion or quiz score alone is insufficient.

records.name: Independent Practitioner — Precision Repair Judgment
records.description: Demonstrate repair judgment, cue recognition, safe stop/escalation, and independent execution.
records.pass_condition: Three supervised repairs + one independent repair + explicit safe stop/escalate demonstration.
records.completion_evidence_policy: Practice evidence + peer approval required; knowledge completion or quiz score alone is insufficient.

notes: Current CertificationPath stores name/description only; steps and pass_condition are canonical world metadata for the module bridge.
Completion requires practice evidence and peer validation; no quiz-only completion.
